Extend the prompt set

When the base matrix needs to grow

The base monthly engagement includes at least 50 prompts. Additional packs cover new services, product categories or buying situations. Expansion is useful when the business introduces an offer whose potential customers ask questions that the current matrix does not yet address.

One pack adds 10 prompts. Starting from 50, that means 60 with 1 pack or 70 with 2 packs. The additional monthly price follows the number of packs selected. The platform set is agreed separately and does not change automatically with the prompt count.

What the main GEO engagement includes →

Choosing the additional questions

We begin with the business objective and then write the questions. For an online store, this might mean choosing products by features and purchase terms. A service business might need prompts for a particular specialization, customer situation or region. Each group should connect to something the business actually offers.

The additional set extends the intent map. I check that prompts cover useful scenarios rather than repeatedly restating the same question. Prompts that contain the brand name are marked separately because they test recognition differently from an independent recommendation.

Find your industry and relevant methodologies →An approach to product and seller questions →

Connecting prompts with the work plan

For each new group, we record initial responses and identify missing facts, pages or supporting sources. The resulting tasks become part of the agreed promotion plan. Expanding the matrix therefore informs what needs to be done as well as what needs to be measured.

Responsibilities follow the main plan. Standard GEO promotion includes website and content briefs; GEO + content also includes content creation. For the financial-guarantee format, changes to the contractual matrix and measurement terms are recorded when the extension is agreed.

Promotion with content creation →Fixed measurement matrix and 3-month BMR targets →

Comparing results after expansion

The original set is retained for comparable repeat measurements. New prompts form an additional group with their own starting point. The report can show overall coverage and each part separately, making changes caused by sample composition visible.

For example, after expanding from 50 to 60 prompts, the original 50 show progress on the existing topics while the additional 10 show the position of the new area. Tell me which services or buying situations you want to add. If another AI platform is also needed, it can be included through a separate option.

FAQ

Questions about this service

How many prompts does one pack add?+
10 prompts beyond the base matrix of 50. If you start with 50 prompts, 1 additional pack gives 60 and 2 packs give 70.
Is the pack a one-off or monthly charge?+
It is a monthly extension to promotion. The additional price increases with the number of prompt packs selected.
Do the new prompts contribute to overall BMR?+
They can be included in the overall report, but the original matrix is retained separately. New questions have their own starting point for a valid comparison.
What information do you need to expand the matrix?+
Specify the services, product categories, markets or buyer situations you want to cover. We use these to prepare additional prompts and align them with promotion objectives.
